title: Connect liquid operators to production fixed ticks
requires: Production runtime/toolchain plus applicable physical GPU; cross-platform build evidence
scope: Bind F8-09/F8-12 liquid prediction, density solve, velocity update and commit through the native fixed-tick public execution path, replacing its blanket liquid rejection when the complete liquid-only lifecycle is supported. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md.
acceptance: An installed public client creates and advances each currently supported liquid representation with exactly one 1/60 advance, one spatial publication and six density iterations; run existing independent liquid oracles.
Neighbor queries consume the common epoch; no per-population/iteration rebuild, hidden substep, serial CPU GPU-physics fallback or double integration.
Cold/warm, free-surface, containment, unequal population sizes, empty capacity, overflow and rollback cases exercise real public production dispatch on an applicable physical GPU.
Retain numerical/workload limits and adapter compilation coverage; successful private kernel tests alone cannot complete this task.
